title: Asset Resolution Contract (Phase 4C Reuse)
description: Defines how Technical Resolution integrates with Phase 4C Multimodal Semantic Matching to select real property media without duplicating ranking logic.
core_reuse_principles: REUSE, DO NOT DUPLICATE: Technical Resolution delegates candidate scoring and ranking directly to 4C (media_ranker.js, intent_extractor.js, editorial_continuity_engine.js).
SEMANTIC RELEVANCE OVER SPEED: Never pick first file or arbitrary CRM position; assets must pass 4C semantic thresholds (room_type, features).
UNIFIED MEDIA CANDIDATES: Seamlessly evaluates both property photos (with Ken Burns) and property video segments (with 1:1 trim).
PHYSICAL INTEGRITY & PROVENANCE: Every selected asset is validated by asset_service with SHA-256 byte verification and property ownership check.

interface_mapping.intent_extractor_bridge: Maps subjects & media_intent to requested_room_types and requested_features
interface_mapping.continuity_engine_execution: Enforces non-repetition, fatigue avoidance, and duration feasibility
interface_mapping.blueprint_compiler: Emits visual_timeline item (kind: 'property_video' with source trim, or kind: 'property_photo' with motion: 'ken_burns')
